dialogues.jp: 「お疲れさん」
dialogues.en: "Same as yesterday."
dialogues.text: "Same as yesterday."

dialogues.jp:
休憩時間になり、眞子がフルート片手にやって
くる。
dialogues.en:
The rest will be omitted because I don't feel up to telling
it.
dialogues.text:
The rest will be omitted because I don't feel up to telling
it.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どうだった？」
dialogues.en: "Okay, my answers are also the same as yesterday."
dialogues.text: "Okay, my answers are also the same as yesterday."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「昨日と同じ」
dialogues.en:
In a change from yesterday's situation, Mako also leans
against the window next to me.
dialogues.text:
In a change from yesterday's situation, Mako also leans
against the window next to me.

dialogues.jp: 以下、かったるいので省略。
dialogues.en: "I've been wondering why your flute looks different."
dialogues.text: "I've been wondering why your flute looks different."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、あたしの答えも昨日と同じだね」
dialogues.en: "You mean this?"
dialogues.text: "You mean this?"

dialogues.jp:
今日は昨日と違って、窓辺に寄りかかる俺の隣
に眞子も寄りかかる。
dialogues.en: Mako lifts her flute to eye level.
dialogues.text: Mako lifts her flute to eye level.

dialogues.jp:
「前から思ってたんだけど、そのいつも持って
　るやつ、変わったフルートだよな」
dialogues.en:
I don't know much about musical instruments, but it is
rather shorter than I'd imagined.
dialogues.text:
I don't know much about musical instruments, but it is
rather shorter than I'd imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、これ？」
dialogues.en:
"This one is called a 'Soprano flute'... My childhood friend
gave me this..."
dialogues.text:
"This one is called a 'Soprano flute'... My childhood friend
gave me this..."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が握っているフルートを持ち上げる。

楽器のことは詳しくないけど、俺のイメージす
るフルートよりも、かなり短い。
dialogues.en: It's a version of a flute.
dialogues.text: It's a version of a flute.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「これは『ソプラノフルート』っていうんだけ
　ど……昔いた幼なじみにもらったやつなんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I've been using this since I was a child, so I still like
to use it."
dialogues.text:
"I've been using this since I was a child, so I still like
to use it."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり一応、フルートなんだ。
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、物持ちがいいんだな。俺の子供
の頃の物なんて残ってたっけ？
dialogues.en:
She can keep things for a long time. Do I still have
anything that I was using when I was a child?
dialogues.text:
She can keep things for a long time. Do I still have
anything that I was using when I was a child?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あっと、もう行かないと」
dialogues.en: "Uh-oh, I have to go back."
dialogues.text: "Uh-oh, I have to go back."

dialogues.jp:
集合がかかり、部員たちがそれぞれの楽器を手
に、持ち場につき始めている。
dialogues.en:
Hearing the starting signal, the members are taking their
spots with their instruments in hand.
dialogues.text:
Hearing the starting signal, the members are taking their
spots with their instruments in hand.

dialogues.jp: 「がんばれよ」
dialogues.en: "Hang in there."
dialogues.text: "Hang in there."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うん。また後でね」
dialogues.en: "Thanks. See you."
dialogues.text: "Thanks. See you."

dialogues.jp:
『ソプラノフルート』？　を持って自分の持ち
場へと戻っていく。
dialogues.en: Mako goes back to her spot with her 'Soprano flute'.
dialogues.text: Mako goes back to her spot with her 'Soprano flute'.

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ……」
dialogues.en: "Well well......"
dialogues.text: "Well well......"

dialogues.jp: 後片づけまで、もう｛しばら／暫｝くボーっとしてますか…。
dialogues.en:
Until it's time to clean up, I can spend time doing
nothing...
dialogues.text:
Until it's time to clean up, I can spend time doing
nothing...

dialogues.jp: 再び、音楽室に眞子たちの演奏が響き始める。
dialogues.en:
The musical performance played by Mako and the others starts
to echo throughout the music room again.
dialogues.text:
The musical performance played by Mako and the others starts
to echo throughout the music room again.

dialogues.jp: ◆ソプラノフルート◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
眞子がいつも吹いている楽器はソプラノフルー
トというらしい。
dialogues.en:
Getting to break time, Mako comes to me with a flute in her
hand.
dialogues.text:
Getting to break time, Mako comes to me with a flute in her
hand.

dialogues.jp:
普通のフルートより小さいとは思ってたけど、
初めて知った。
dialogues.en: "How was it?"
dialogues.text: "How was it?"
